description: Bike Share Dock Locations is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This dataset show the historical Melbourne Bike Share docks. This program came to an end in November 2019. Contains the bike share dock locations that were deployed across Melbourne as part of the Melbourne Bike Share Program. Melbourne Bike Share is a joint RACV/Victorian Government bicycle hire scheme. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are bicycle, bike, bike share, entrepreneur, eventsplanner, live. The portal shows 50 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
